title: Connected apps
description: Let applications such as LibreChat sign members in with their Godar account. Each member reaches only the models Godar allows them.

integration.title: Integration details
integration.description: Enter these values in the application's OpenID Connect settings, together with the client ID and secret of the app you register below.

table.name: Name
table.searchPlaceholder: Search by name, client ID, or URI
table.emptyDescription: Register an application to let members sign in to it with Godar.

fields.name: App name
fields.nameHelp: Members see this name on the Godar sign-in page.
fields.redirectURIsHelp: One per line. Sign-in only returns to these exact addresses. For LibreChat use https://chat.example.com/oauth/openid/callback, replacing the domain with yours.
fields.logoutURIsHelp: One per line. Where the app may send members after they sign out.
fields.activeHelp: An inactive app cannot sign anyone in or refresh its tokens. Access tokens already issued stop working when they expire.

form.createDescription: The client secret is shown once, right after you register the app.
form.editDescription: Changes apply to the next sign-in.

secret.createdTitle: App registered: copy the client secret now
secret.rotatedTitle: New client secret: copy it now
secret.description: {name} (client ID {clientID}). The secret cannot be shown again.
secret.warning: Store the secret in the application's configuration before closing this dialog. If it is lost, generate a new one.

rotateDialog.title: Generate a new client secret?
rotateDialog.description: The current secret of "{name}" stops working immediately. Update the application with the new secret, or members cannot sign in to it.

deleteDialog.title: Delete this app?
deleteDialog.description: "{name}" can no longer sign anyone in, and every member is signed out of it when their current access token expires. This cannot be undone.

messages.loadError: Connected apps could not be loaded. Try again.
messages.createError: The app could not be registered. Try again.
messages.updateError: The app could not be updated. Try again.
messages.rotateError: A new secret could not be generated. Try again.
messages.deleteError: The app could not be deleted. Try again.
messages.copyError: Copying failed. Select the value and copy it manually.

errors.invalid_payload: Check the form and try again.
errors.name_required: Enter a name for the app.
errors.name_too_long: The name must be 120 characters or fewer.
errors.redirect_required: Enter at least one redirect URI.
errors.redirect_invalid: "{value}" is not allowed. Use a full https address without a # fragment. http is accepted only for localhost.

apiErrors.oidc_client_invalid: Godar rejected this configuration. Check the redirect URIs and try again.
apiErrors.oidc_client_not_found: This app no longer exists. The list has been refreshed.
apiErrors.oidc_client_conflict: An app with the same client ID already exists. Try again.
apiErrors.forbidden: Only tenant admins can manage connected apps.

forbidden.title: Tenant admin access required
forbidden.description: Only tenant admins can register applications that sign members in with Godar.
